trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker manipulates pool price around liquidity addition; block.timestamp deadline and no TWAP validation.

direct_effect.reason: Protocol adds liquidity at unfavorable rate, receiving less liquidity value than it should.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected fair-rate liquidity addition vs actual unfavorable rate; value conservation violated via extraction.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable function, the sandwich-attack trigger, the unfavorable-rate value loss effect, and a fair-rate/value-conservation basis sufficient to attempt formalization.
